scope: Read-only visual review of eight new Opera interior captures from the final exported v0.1.4 App in the full city, after the airport-road/fountain correction; four exterior Opera views excluded.

artifact.hash_kind: Final App distribution ZIP archive, matching current build.json

result: All eight final-build images individually inspected. No new blocking visual geometry or view-obstruction defects found; previously recorded minor appearance limitations remain.

observations: Unobstructed audience view of raised stage, organ, choir seats and magenta reflector groups.
Timber ceiling and side enclosures are continuous; the earlier white roof pieces and bronze louvres do not intrude.
Side aisles and seating terraces remain legible.
nonblocking_limitations: Timber and seating are visibly simplified procedural geometry; this is not a photographic reproduction.

observations: Reverse stage view shows the curved stalls, upper seating, side circulation and enclosing rear timber wall.
No exterior sky, glass or louvre cuts through the audience enclosure.
nonblocking_limitations: Repeated seating and timber surfaces have relatively uniform material and lighting treatment.

observations: Organ pipes, choir terrace, reflector suspension and stage access stairs are visible.
No white shell fragment intersects the organ or timber ceiling in this view.
nonblocking_limitations: Foreground seats and hanging reflectors naturally crop parts of the view; the organ is a representative pipe array.

observations: The central rear camera shows the proscenium, stage, two levels of side boxes and audience seating.
The stage rear and acoustic ceiling are enclosed; the earlier bright exterior window and louvre obstruction are absent.
nonblocking_limitations: Dark stage lighting and simplified drapery provide limited scenic detail; no live event is depicted.

observations: Ticket counter, broad foyer floor, folded concrete ribs, strip lighting and access stairs are visible.
The ribs terminate around the upper stair opening; no rib visibly crosses its climbing path.
nonblocking_limitations: The large foyer has sparse furnishings and simple counter detail.

observations: The stair flight, handrails and upper opening are clearly visible.
Decorative concrete ribs stop at the opening, preserving the visible stair path.
The roof and glazing visible above the opening belong to the upper foyer context.
nonblocking_limitations: Some fine highlight or shadow speckling is visible near stair edges; a static image cannot establish temporal flicker.

observations: Purple broad steps, railing, landing and harbour-facing glazing are present.
The water horizon is visible through the glazing, with no opaque auditorium wall blocking the foyer view.
nonblocking_limitations: Thin bright lines remain between some stair risers.
Foyer furniture and glazing detail are simplified.

observations: Red broad steps, railing and landing sit behind the large glazed harbour frontage.
Water and distant shoreline context are visible; overhead exterior louvre tips do not block the public floor in this image.
nonblocking_limitations: Thin bright lines remain between some stair risers.
Foyer furnishings and materials remain sparse and simplified.

component_triangle_sampling.count_semantics: One shared total of sampled exterior triangle points tested against both room volumes; do not add the repeated Concert and JST log counts.

review_limits: Static screenshots do not independently verify movement, collision, frame rate or every unseen surface.
The simplified procedural interiors are not represented as a measured, seat-for-seat or photographic reconstruction.
review_method: All eight current PNGs were reopened and visually inspected after the final rebuild. Prior candidate observations were rechecked against the new images, not carried forward without inspection.
